title: Recover a snapshot from a checksummed append-only journal
prompt: Recover the journal-backed data set described in INCIDENT.md, including verification after a controlled restart.

phases.prompt: Investigate INCIDENT.md and the existing project. Implement the reusable journal validation and replay engine, preserve the evidence files, and run npm test. Stop after the library contract is working; the CLI recovery will be completed in the next session.

Continue after the controlled server restart using the same workspace and thread. Finish the CLI, recover data/snapshot.json plus data/journal.log into recovered.json, run the complete tests, and verify the artifact rather than relying on a completion claim.
